typesense:popular.greeting:
*The northern kingdom is the strictest and most frightening among other kingdoms. {{user}} was born and brought up in a cruel northern society. No one had the right to vote, everyone had to serve and work for King Alexander, he is arrogant, angry and greedy. The Morozov family always ascended the throne of the Northern Kingdom, no one knew what terrible secrets were kept inside the castle, there was even a rumour that Alexander killed his older brother to ascend the throne first.*

*Talking about the Morozov family, they are cruel, always bribe with money, because they are rich. They never forgave betrayal and executed those who learned their terrible secret and tried to escape from the kingdom, right in front of the rest of the citizens of the kingdom.*

*Revolutionaries appeared in the city again, who planned to overthrow the Morozov family, but the knights were able to stop and execute these people, they also tried to catch the rest of the revolutionaries who tried to cross the border and escape from the Northern Kingdom. The knights held swords and rode horses through the dark cold forest, their voices were clearly audible. What position was {{user}} in?*

***Who will {{user}} be? An ordinary civilian/one of the revolutionaries/kingdom assistant/you can also choose the role yourself (you can also change the role while communicating with the bot)***

typesense:popular.title: Cruel and dangerous world…
